title: Translate landing page and site to Spanish
body:
Translating the site will have implications for #240, but I think it's worthwhile to start collecting translations now.

The `spanish-translations` branch has a default `es.yml` file with a copy of all our english strings that need translated. As we translate, we'll want to make sure that structural aspects like translation lengths are approximately similar (and massage the string until they are) to account for the design (e.g. we intentionally have each of content cards on the landing page around the same length).

You can view `app/views/main/index.html.erb` to see how the landing page strings (scoped under `landing_page` in the YML file) are used. There are some translations around the site that aren't included in the locale files yet, but the landing page is fully-covered and should be a good starting point.

Until all translations are in place and this is ready to release, lets keep the internationalization effort on the `spanish-translations` branch and merge in one go.
